Negative source waste references require factor-1 to positive treatment helpers. Open-burning/open-dump/unsanitary branches use complete inspected source-emission helpers: no physical emission, fossil/biogenic split, land, water, resource flow or marginal uncertainty is omitted, and no branch is replaced by controlled disposal or empty allocation. The unsanitary native diesel-MJ and skid-steer-m3 services reuse exact earlier operating inventory witnesses; retain their technology, fleet/filter, allocation, geography and vintage limitations, without extra fuel or infrastructure. Controlled fractions use complete native ordinary mixed-plastic incineration/sanitary-landfill or untreated-wood incineration, with all44 declared composition/heating-value coordinates matched to native2026; unknown entries stay unknown. Native2025 comments are shorter but full inventories and positive references are inspected. Native controlled-process emissions, biosphere coverage, water/oxygen, residue, background energy, allocation, technology, geography and vintage differ; score effects are unquantified and no LCIA equality is claimed. The source3.12wood comment reports3.5MJ thermal output versus native3.49MJ; retain the complete native service with an explicit reporting/performance limitation, not an efficiency correction or added heat credit. Do not rescale by product-name moisture labels: actual composition matches; no dry-mass/heating-value, capacity, lifetime or allocation multiplier is introduced. Preserve original road and country-specific rail tkm separately through complete native RER same-mode freight services. The inspected CN/RoW rail markets include steam, electric and diesel supply; their whole-country traction mixes are geographic/fleet proxies, not individual steam-to-electric correspondences. Original source country freight quantities and uncertainty remain intact, while vehicle/traction/fuel/load/age/duty/background shares are not reconstructed. No extra vehicle, road or track is added. Canonical source biosphere labels use the same publisher UUID/unit/full receiving context in3.10. CAS/label metadata changes, including calcium/sodium ionic labels and missing NOx/PCB CAS, are retained as warnings; no chemical stoichiometry, charge/mass conversion, speciation proxy or compartment relocation is inferred. Retain the3.12wood controlled-branch nonphysical waste indicator once outside the native process, which lacks it; keep its exact source amount where supported, or omit only that indicator with an explicit warning and omission audit under the existing policy. Preserve caller signed quantities, uncertainty, formulas, ownership, separate emissions and collection. No new recycling/recovery credit, fly-ash-extraction proxy, paperboard disposal proxy, inverse or cross-system-model route is added. Only the three enumerated exact cut-off profiles qualify. Raw child-rule hashes are drift witnesses, not approval of unrelated heuristic endpoints.
